desc:
🍖 Welcome to Throw Food For Baddies!

How to Play:
🥕 Throw food as far as you can, and nail the PERFECT throw for extra power
🍀 Your luck climbs the farther your food flies through each area
💃 Attract and collect Baddies, from Common all the way to Secret
📏 Pull Big, Huge and even Colossal Baddies for more Money/s
💰 Your Baddies earn you money, even while you're offline
🍔 Buy better food to attract rarer Baddies
💪 Train on pull-up bars to gain Throwing Strength
🌍 Throw farther to reach new areas with rarer Baddies
🧬 Fuse Baddies together for mutations
👥 Play with friends for +15% income each!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for Best Pull, Most Baddies and Top Money/s
